newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar corrects lower helped by weak NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar corrects lower helped by weak NY.

text.p: White sugar futures took another swing to the downside on Friday afternoon after the open of the New York raws market but the weakness was seen as just a correction to the recent bounce in values, traders said.
The spot December contract staged a series of sharp declines which culminated in a reaction low of $325.00 earlier this week but has since clawed its way higher.
Traders said the whites market was still fundamentally weak and the bearish sentiment was not helped by the performance on the raws market. "London is coming down in line with New York," said one.
"It's correcting itself after that bounce...but the volume isn't fantastic," he said.
At 1533 GMT December was hovering at an intraday low of $329.00, down $2.60 on the day. March was down $2.10 at $329.50.

Total volume reached 1,937 lots, dominated by trades in December, but at least 800 lots of the 1,206-lot spot turnover was reported to derive from crossed trades. Technical analysts pegged December's nearby support levels at $328 and $326, but noted that recent strength had dragged the 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) out of oversold territory.
Paris positions were also weaker in line with London but volume was much lighter at 341 lots. December was down $1.50 at $330.00 and March down $3.00 at $329.00.
